answer: Each newcomer signs 256 registrar challenges with Schnorr nonces drawn from local hardware entropy and locks a 30 token bond. Cloned VM snapshots replay identical RNG state, so two identities that reuse a nonce leak both private keys, and any independent watcher who submits the colliding pair claims the bond. A 10,000 clone swarm booted from 40 snapshots produces 9,960 colliding identities, forfeiting 298,800 tokens, about $150,000 at $0.50. Honest hosts show a collision delta near zero. The swarm cracks along shared seams like basalt columns cooled from one lagoon of lava.
